def binarySearch(array, x) -> bool:

    # loop header (can do for or while loop)
    l = 0, r = len(array) - 1
    while l < r: 
        # loop body
        mid = (l + r) / 2
        if array[mid] == x:
            return True
        if array[mid] > x:
            r = mid - 1
        else:
            l = mid + 1
   

    # return statement
    return False
